name: Morning AI News (EU Market)
job: Scan AI news from the last 12 hours and write a comprehensive SEO-optimized article for the European audience. Focus on the most significant AI development, trend, or breakthrough. Target length: 800-1200 words. Include 2-3 relevant affiliate links naturally based on article topic. Save to website/content/blog/ with filename format: YYYY-MM-DD-descriptive-slug.md

name: Evening AI News (US Market)
job: Scan AI news from the last 12 hours and write a comprehensive SEO-optimized article for the US audience. Select a DIFFERENT topic than the morning article to provide variety. Target length: 800-1200 words. Include 2-3 relevant affiliate links naturally based on article topic. Save to website/content/blog/ with filename format: YYYY-MM-DD-descriptive-slug-us.md
